title.value: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
title.provenance: AN  ACT  to  amend  the  environmental  conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or  wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

status.provenance: Introduced  by  M.  of  A.  GALLAGHER,  STERN, GONZALEZ-ROJAS, JACOBSON, LEVENBERG, SIMON, SIMONE, ROSENTHAL,  COLTON,  REYES,  SHIMSKY,  RAGA, CLARK,  SEAWRIGHT, FORREST, OTIS, BURDICK, MAMDANI, MEEKS -- read once and referred to the Committee on Environmental Conservation -- committee discharged, bill amended, ordered reprinted as amended and  recommitted to said committee

pfas_definition.provenance: "Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" or "PFAS substances" means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: No person shall sell or offer for sale in this state anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances as intentionally added chemicals or that contain perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances at or above a level that the department shall establish in regulation.

date.provenance: After December thirty-first, two thousand twenty-six

who.provenance: No person shall sell or offer for sale in this state anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

action.provenance: No person shall sell or offer for sale in this state anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

products.provenance: anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

exceptions.provenance: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes shall be held in violation of this section if they can show that they relied in good faith on the written assurance of the manufacturer of such product that such product met the requirements of this section.

intentionally_added.provenance: containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances as intentionally added chemicals
